messages:
Maya (CS): quick weekly health snapshot for Orion Health onboarding — pulling p95/p99 by route + model and stream vs non-stream. High level: overall usage steady, but p99 regression on streaming for model-rdx-1.2. spend +18% last 7d, error rate up to 1.1% (from 0.2%).
Sam (Eng): can you drop the raw numbers? want to see if it's specific to a route or model combo.
Maya (CS): here are the query results (7d window):
```
route                 | model        | mode           | p95   | p99   | errors | avg tokens
/v1/chat/orion-convo  | model-rdx-1.2| streaming      | 240ms | 1.2s  | 0.9%   | 420
/v1/chat/orion-convo  | model-rdx-1.2| non-streaming  | 180ms | 340ms | 0.15%  | 380
/v1/emb/search-rerank | model-emb-s1  | non-streaming  | 45ms  | 120ms | 0.05%  | 64
/v1/summarize/batch   | model-rdx-1.1| streaming      | 130ms | 360ms | 0.4%   | 720
```
Maya (CS): notes: the big delta is streaming p99 for orion-convo with model-rdx-1.2 — it's ~1.2s, whereas non-stream is 340ms. retries look correlated to the p99 spikes.
Sam (Eng): that screams cache/KV cold misses + dequantization overhead. Do we have recent rollouts for rdx-1.2 kernels? @Sanjay any infra changes?
Sanjay (Infra): we deployed a kernel tweak two nights ago to reduce memory for rdx-1.2 on packed-quant lanes. It improves throughput but can increase tail latency in low-batch streaming cases. I scheduled a canary rollback for 1918876800 if we confirm it's the culprit.
Alex (AM): FYI: Orion's QBR is next week; they're noticing lag in the live chat flow. Renewal conversation may hinge on smooth UX. If we don't show a near-term mitigation, risk moves from "watch" to "at risk".
Maya (CS): action items: 1) Sam to run a streaming-tail trace for /v1/chat/orion-convo (depth sampling @ 1%) — Sam to report by EOD. 2) Sanjay to hold rollback canary unless trace suggests otherwise. 3) Ops to enable prefix KV cache for this customer route for 48h trial. 4) Alex to prep briefing for Orion about temporary mitigation and offer a Dedicated trial.
Sam (Eng): starting trace now. initial suspicion: batching drops to 1-2 tokens for some sessions => kernel path falls back and triggers high p99. if so, we can tweak batching/policy.
ops-bot: deploy 1918873550 of infra/kernels -> completed on packed-quant-nodes :white_check_mark:
Maya (CS): thanks all. I'll capture these in the onboarding ticket and set a follow-up check-in Thurs 11:00am PT. @Alex please ping if you want a pre-QBR runbook. :eyes:
Alex (AM): will do, thanks Maya.
Sam (Eng): quick note — also saw a small spike in cost per 1k tokens for this route due to retries; expect spend delta of ~18% if retries persist (matches Maya's number).
Maya (CS): logged in tracker: https://redwood.example/track/ORION-4287 — will update the thread after Sam's trace.
